title: [US] Shop Health
label: TIKTOK SHOP · PARTNER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2025-11-17
html:
Introduction

For U.S. L2L partners, the Health Center > Shop Health module on TTSPC centralizes key data for your signed sellers. No more switching to Seller Center, you can access seller health scores (AHR/SPS/CHR) and violation records directly in TTSPC. The module also highlights sellers with abnormal scores and offers flexible filters, helping you streamline governance and act proactively.

What Are the Benefits?

  • Save time on data access: Skip logging into Seller Center. Partners now can view all critical seller health and violation data in TTSPC.
  • Prioritize high-risk cases: Quickly identify sellers with abnormal scores or declining health to focus on your follow-up efforts.
  • Reduce GMV loss: Address violations faster with clear visibility, lowering revenue impact from unhandled issues.

Step by Step Guide

Step 1 Get Required Authorization

Required Authorization

  • Shop health/performance data: Sellers must authorize at least one Seller Center Access role (Full Access/Customer Service/Order Fulfillment/Product Access/Ad Manager/Affiliate).
  • TikTok account health data: Permissions follow the same scope as Seller Center Data Compass.

How to get authorization:

Detailed userguide: TSP Access Authorization Guide.

For sellers

  • For new seller: When the seller authorizes TSP service through an authorization link, sellers choose Seller center access role to allow TSP access the specific authorized pages on the seller center。

  • For signed seller: Signed seller can edit authorization through Find partner >"..." > my service > Edit

For Partners

  • In TTSPC > seller management, if there is no Permission role authorization / Data Compass authorization, you can click "..." > Edit > Request permissions > Edit selection,and then send seller request links. The seller can open the link to complete the TSP access authorization.

Step 2 Access the Shop Health Module

You can reach the module in the following 2 ways, and the data updates are shown in the top-right corner.

  1. Direct entry: Log in to TTSPC > Health > Seller

  1. Homepage shortcut: Check the "Shop Health Overview" on TTSPC Home, then click View More to open the full module.

Step 3 Use Health Overview

This section displays the number of signed sellers with notably abnormal scores. Hover over the "?" icon for quick explanations of each score.

Step 4 Dive Into Health List

Shop Health and Performance List

Filters and definitions

Fields Definition Options
Shop info This is used to query specific shops. -Shop name
-Shop code
-Shop ID
Shop Health Rating (AHR)
AHR provides a snapshot of the overall health of the seller's account. It reflects the points the seller has earned and lost based on shop activities over the last 180 days.
-Deactivated (0)
-Poor (1-50)
-Fair (51-199)
-Excellent (200-1000)
Shop Performance Score (SPS) SPS is a zero to five (0–5) system focused on helping grow the shop. The shop will be scored after delivering at least 30 orders (excluding fake orders and sample orders) in the past 90 calendar days. The SPS is determined by metrics related to product satisfaction, fulfillment -0-2.5
-2.5-3.5
-3.5-4.5
-4.5-5
Shop health action required
Show only ratings that have decreased by more than 20 compared to yesterday or 7 days ago. Results sorted by GMV in descending order.
Checkbox
Shop Performance Score action required Show only scores that have decreased by more than 0.5 compared to yesterday or 7 days ago. Results sorted by GMV in descending order. Checkbox
Comparison This is used to set the comparison time range in "attention" and the details list.
-Yesterday
-Last 7 days

Detail info

Note: without permission, only store information & account information are displayed, relevant data will show "-"

Fields Functions
Shop info Show avatar, shop name, shop code
Shop health status Displays the real-time health status of the shop, using colors to distinguish different states.
-Excellent: ≥200
-Fair: 51-199
-Poor: 1-50
-Deactivated: ≤0
Last 7 days GMV Supports ascending and descending sorting
Shop health rating (AHR)
Supports ascending and descending sorting, and displays fluctuations within the time range in “Comparison”
Shop Performance Score(SPS) Supports ascending and descending sorting, and displays fluctuations within the time range in “Comparison”
Last 7 days violations Counts the past 7 days violations from Seller Center > Shop Health > Violation Records where Enforcement status is Enforced/ No action/ Pending
Last 60 days violations Counts the past 7 days violations from Seller Center > Shop Health > Violation Records where Enforcement status is Enforced/ No action/ Pending
Appealable violations Counts the past 60 days violations from Seller Center > Shop Health > Violation Records where appeal status is Not appealed/Failed appeal (can appeal again)
Actions
When permissions are available, click "Visit Seller Center" to jump to Seller center - Account health - Shop health to view more details


When permissions are unavailable, click "Request authorization" to open the edit Service proposal page of Seller management.
